AgentControl.title: AgentControl
AgentControl.description:
Body of ``POST /v1/agents/{id}:<action>`` (``{}`` for every action but a scoped cancel).

``session_id`` scopes ``cancel`` to one conversation: only that session's running run is
aborted and only its undelivered messages are abandoned; other callers' work is untouched.

DecisionEvaluate.title: DecisionEvaluate
DecisionEvaluate.description:
One decision request. ``state`` is built and redacted by the caller; ``context`` carries
facts the caller's code already knows (kill flag, grants, network, entropy) so they are
passed to the model as facts instead of being asked.

DecisionLabel.title: DecisionLabel
DecisionLabel.description: ``correct`` is whether the *outcome* was right (an approved ``confirm`` was not).

ExternalApprovalIn.title: ExternalApprovalIn
ExternalApprovalIn.description: A service mirrors one of its own pending approvals into ags (upsert by kind + ref).

FurnacePrepass.description: Lets ags compute ``value_usd`` (the downstream saving of a local fold).
FurnacePrepass.title: FurnacePrepass

SandboxLimitsIn.description: Requested bounds; ags clamps them to its own ceilings.
SandboxLimitsIn.title: SandboxLimitsIn

SandboxMountIn.description: A host path under one of ags' mount roots, mounted at ``sandbox_path`` (relative).
SandboxMountIn.title: SandboxMountIn

HouseBenchmarkRow.description: One model's latest house score for a kind, next to what it did on live calls.
HouseBenchmarkRow.title: HouseBenchmarkRow

HouseItemMetaOut.description: An item's metadata. Prompts, references and namespaces are never returned.
HouseItemMetaOut.title: HouseItemMetaOut

RunCall.description: One model response of a run (Phase 6.2a): served model, tokens, cost and its source.
RunCall.title: RunCall

PublicAgentMonitor.description: Owner-scoped durable metadata; never prompts, configs or tool payloads.
PublicAgentMonitor.title: PublicAgentMonitor

operation.const: Execute argument vector in agent VM
operation.title: Operation

CatalogSnapshotModel.description: One model row of the catalog snapshot. ``band`` is None for local/custom endpoints.
CatalogSnapshotModel.title: CatalogSnapshotModel

CatalogBands.description:
The generator's four id tuples in catalog order.

``cheap_fast`` access sees ``cheaper_slow`` + ``cheap_fast_only``; ``free`` is always visible.
CatalogBands.title: CatalogBands

CatalogAccessPicker.description:
Model-picker data for one access ceiling (local/custom rows are not included).

``model_ids`` are both the allowed and the manual models, in picker order; names and
descriptions come from the matching ``CatalogSnapshotModel`` rows.
CatalogAccessPicker.title: CatalogAccessPicker

CatalogSnapshot.description: Everything pg reads from the model catalog (``GET /v1/catalog/snapshot``).
CatalogSnapshot.title: CatalogSnapshot
